newsitem.title: CHINA: China rubber shortfall seen at 600,000 T in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China rubber shortfall seen at 600,000 T in 1997.

text.p: China will produce about one million tonnes of rubber in 1997, about 600,000 tonnes short of expected domestic demand, the Economic Daily said on Friday.
China would make some 440,000 tonnes of natural rubber and 560,000 tonnes of synthetic rubber this year, the newspaper said.
Demand was seen at about 1.6 million tonnes this year, the newspaper said.
"Imports of rubber this year will not be lower than the overall level last year," it said.
China imported 450,000 tonnes of natural rubber and 300,000 tonnes of synthetic rubber last year, it said.

Rubber production last year totalled 970,000 tonnes, with 420,000 tonnes being natural rubber and 550,000 tonnes being synthetic, it said. Earlier estimates by the Ministry of Chemical Industry have said China would produce 430,000 tonnes of natural rubber and 620,000 tonnes of synthetic rubber.
The ministry forecast demand to be 1.68 million tonnes.
